native_and_step_validation.representation: Previous accepted solid STEP body with the same M6 interface cuts; unchanged cover. Export head cutter overruns its nominal Y7.9 end by0.0001 mm only into the pre-existing empty fork gap to clear numerical wafer.

step_representation_comparison.method: Use the prior accepted solid STEP representation with the same three local M6 cutters; compare all vertices to actual opposite surfaces rather than requiring matching seam vertices.

trimmed_surface_comparison.method: Bidirectional interior UV samples explicitly inside trimmed face domains; measure against candidate opposite CAD faces, not opposite vertices.
trimmed_surface_comparison.interpretation: Every face was sampled in both directions. Maximum sampled interior distance is 0.002236388 mm (2.237 micrometers). This is a finite sampling comparison, not a certified global surface-error bound; the tighter vertex result does not bound all surface interiors.

default_mass_property_comparison.method: FreeCAD Shape.Volume with default OCCT integration settings; these are numerical mass properties, not an independent dimensional comparison.
default_mass_property_comparison.interpretation: Default mass integration depends on the native versus STEP surface representation and on numerical integration settings. The discrepancy changes after the interface cuts and is not treated as a constant offset, evidence of equivalent removed volume, or a measured physical geometry difference. Surface and interface comparisons are recorded separately.

adaptive_mass_property_comparison.api: pythonocc bundled with FreeCAD, BRepGProp.VolumeProperties adaptive Eps overload
adaptive_mass_property_comparison.interpretation: Unresolved numerical mass-property uncertainty: changing integration settings changes both individual volumes and their difference, and reported relative error remains above the requested tolerance. No exact mass or volume equality is claimed. The finite surface sample comparison and hinge-interface dimensions are independent geometry evidence; they do not prove a global surface bound or explain the entire mass discrepancy.

m6_hinge_revision.body_volume_method: FreeCAD default Shape.Volume; see the separate default and adaptive mass-property comparisons for numerical uncertainty.
